author: Alexander
title: Doge's career towards the bottom
text:
What happens with the acquisition of the key institutions of the US government for the richest man in the world and his strike force of former interns is that it is happening very fast.
Three weeks have passed since Elon Musk agents took care of the Government’s IT and Human Resources departments. Since then, the movements of their so -called Government’s efficiency department have had the cartography of a horror film, Dege choosing the agencies one by one based on Slasher’s logic, feeding an insufficient thirst for cost reduction and data .
Every day brings new incursions. Three weeks ago, the United States believed in humanitarian aid. He helped people who had been scammed by large corporations. Financed the necessary infrastructure to make the United States a lighthouse of scientific innovation. The United States Agency for International Development is now destroyed, the Consumer Financial Protection Office is in ICE and the subsidies of the National Health Institutes are handcuffed. Too much for all that.
These are cruelty of spreadsheet, executed with one click. The loss of the works and lives of the royal peoples, yes, despite what the theorists of the X-Famus conspiracy will tell him, Usaid saved lives, all irrelevant compared to the search for a more strict general balance.
Three weeks ago, a 19 -year -old named “Large Balls” online did not have access to government personnel records and more. A 25 -year -old with a closet full of racist tweets had not obtained the keys to the treasury systems paid $ 5.45 billion every year. Elon Musk had not turned the Oval office into a Mameluco room for his 4 -year -old son.
Speed ​​is the strategy, of course, flooding the area so that neither the media nor the courts can keep the pace. Judicial demands and orders move on a different time scale to this cutting and burning approach. (At this rate, Dege will have taken advantage of the last government server long before the Supreme Court has the opportunity to intervene). But it is also reflective. The first business order in a corporate acquisition is to reduce costs as quickly as possible. If you can’t say goodbye to people, offer shopping. If you do not take purchases, find a way to fire them anyway. Keep cutting until you hit bone.
This is how you get a Executive order Declating that “each agency does not hire no more than one employee for every four employees that start”, an arbitrary relationship without taking into account the real personnel needs. This is how you get hundreds of federal government buildings in the auction block, regardless of how busy they are. It is extreme and poorly considered, a race to empty the only good of the city.
And then … what? This is the question that Elon Musk and Dogs have not answered, because there is no answer. Does the United States government need to become a profit engine? To return the value of the shareholder? Does Medicaid need to demonstrate a product product adjustment for the next financing round?
This is the logic of consultants. This is an engineering sprint whose inevitable finish line is the unwinding of the social contract. Democracy does not die in the dark after all; He dies in Jira tickets presented by Palantir students.
(Tagstotranslate) Policy laboratory with Cable
